request: A change written in a language this command cannot measure must be refused and name the stack, instead of being reported as a run in which there was nothing to do.

defects.description: Own-history fix 9069c2cc9e (2026-10-25): fix(mutate): a Python change is a refusal, not a nothing-to-do

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > internal/mutate/mutate_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestPythonChangeIsRefusedByName|TestGoChangeWithoutProductionSourceIsQuiet)$' ./internal/mutate >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
